fails_if: any one of: `_source_native_identity_supported` (source_formation.py) stops retaining a complete native quantity across nonconcurrent column renames (seq, blk, h56, case, dia, grain report unresolved_native_identity and form nothing, or case and dia fold onto one spelling), or retains one whose name, definition, column, Datatyp or period is missing or contrary, or whose columns are co-delivered (noname, nodef, nocol, notype, noperiod, rename, redefine, codeliv, distinct gain states), or retains a native quantity in a family that holds a checked addition (checked keeps X0115 2004 and x0115 2005 apart with a retained warning instead of folding 2004 onto x0115); the fold renames a checked addition (checked's 2002 state reads x0115) or folds co-delivered twins (codeliv forms a variable); a partition's checked case twins fold (gaturest loses GatuRest or Gaturest); formation keeps a common unit when deliveries disagree or one lacks a unit (units-seq, units-same, units-missing publish a variable unit), counts a columnless member's unit (units-columnless loses SEK), or stops keeping units, types and operational definitions on the delivery state (grain); a pooled edition stops forming one pooled state (pooled) or its coding stops binding over the pooled range (pooled-coded loses 01 One); a columnless member downgrades a sibling's unsupported period to a warning (colless-unplaced's no_supported_states becomes a warning); `unknown_data_type` drops the documented types or storage waves from its detail (ty-conflict), or a widened type drops its provenance or keeps a length (ty-widen); an open Data till stops reaching 9999-12-31 with its codes (open); a code-list member's validity stops cutting the state (split) or the list version label is not written (coded); or a formed variable's coverage claim stops matching the state it writes (an unexplained_delivery_coverage_loss issue appears)
note: One variable per old test or parametrize row, in one build, so the issues projections can say which legs retain a native quantity, which refuse it and which fold. Expected values are the old tests' asserted values read through the fixture. Translations the delivered sources force: (1) the SCB reader classifies Datatyp at read, so ty-widen's provenance lists 'decimal, text' where the old test's hand-built records carried 'float, varchar', and grain's float is decimal (as in occurrence-states-reconcile-facts-on-exact-intervals). (2) No SCB delivery cuts one occurrence at a member's validity (an edition-listed SCB item's ValidDates are set aside, value-native-lists-bind-set-aside-or-withhold-per-register), and SOS code lists carry no version label, so the old test's one claim is split: SPLIT shows the member window cutting the state at year grain (members 1, 2, 1, as the old test's day-grain cut), CODED shows the list's version label written on its state. (3) The old checked-owner tests marked a member identity_checked by hand; a build marks the members an identity entry assigns, so an [[errata.delivered]] addition is the checked X0115 2002 member. The old never-automatic test's single unchecked column (NEW) could never retain a native quantity (formation needs two unchecked spellings, source_formation.py `len(columns) > 1`), so checked carries the harder shape: two unchecked nonconcurrent case twins that would retain without the checked member, which instead fold onto the most recent spelling while the checked member keeps its literal. A build marks only additions checked inside a family that also holds unchecked members (an identity entry moves its members to an owner whose members are all checked), and an addition carries no original source record, so `_source_native_identity_supported` refuses this family on the addition's missing source records, its support records and its occurrence key as well as on the checked flag. (4) FDB's partition and formation steps run in the build, so the old test's per-binding formation is the two split variables' states; its first half (two case twins retained without a declaration) is the case leg. (5) The old coverage tests' positive halves are the build's own delivery-coverage gate: every leg's coverage claim matches its written state, so the build reports no unexplained_delivery_coverage_loss (the refusal halves are rows of test_delivery_coverage_obligations.py, and the type and attribution claims formation mints for that gate stay a direct test in test_source_formation_coverage.py, because no build reaches the gate's refusals). The correction-attribution half is checked's 2002 state, whose provenance carries the [[errata.delivered]] correction's attribution. Not reachable: test_source_native_default_refuses_incomplete_complete_family[variant] (an SCB row always names its variant, scb_records.py SourceCoordinate(status="value") for the variant; an SOS row with no Deldatamängd is another native variable, because the SOS variable key carries its subset). Issues outside the claim: the build also reports unknown_support_key for the default Unika rows of the blank and whitespace columns, and SOS's unknown_classification_declaration; every projection names its subjects.

sources.description: Register TESTREG (1): variant 10 (people) and, for FDB, 11 (second). Each SCB variable is one leg; its rows share the var_row defaults (name GenericVar, definition 'A generic family label', Datatyp int) unless noted, member CVID = var_id * 10 + 1, 2, 3, RegVerID = the year. Retained native quantities, one column per year: seq (401) OLD 2020 / NEW 2021; blk (402) BLK / BLKFTG; h56 (403) H56 / H5_6; case (404) v0115 2004 / V0115 2005 / V0115 2006; dia (405) Kön 2020 / Kon 2021; grain (406) G_OLD 2020 int, SEK, 'Survey formula' / G_NEW 2021 float, KSEK, 'Register formula'. Incomplete families, N?_OLD 2020 / second 2021 / N?_THIRD 2022 with the second withholding one fact: noname (411, blank Variabelnamn), nodef (412, blank definition), nocol (413, a whitespace-only Kolumnnamn), notype (414, blank Datatyp), noperiod (415, the unparseable edition 'okänd', RegVerID 2999). Contrary families: rename (416, second named 'Contrary quantity'), redefine (417, second defined so). codeliv (418): Niva (Datalängd 3) and Nivå (Datalängd 1) both in the 2020 edition; distinct (419): D_OLD and D_NEW both in 2020. checked (421): X0115 2004 / x0115 2005, plus an [[errata.delivered]] X0115 in 2002, the edition anchor (422) delivers. fdb (430, FDB 1.830's shape): GatuRest 1999 and Gaturest 2005 in people, GatuRest 2010 and Gaturest 2015 in second, PGaturest 2020 (people) and 2025 (second), partitioned GatuRest and Gaturest to gaturest, PGaturest to pgaturest. Units: units-seq (441) 'Kronor (SEK)' 2020 / '1000-tal kronor (KSEK)' 2021 in U_SEQ; units-same (442) the same two units on two 2020 members of U_SAME; units-columnless (443) SEK on U_COLLESS 2020 and KSEK on a literal blank column 2021; units-missing (444) SEK 2020 and no unit 2021. pooled (451): the pooled edition '2012 - 2014'; pooled-coded (452): the pooled edition '2020 - 2022' (RegVerID 2120) with one Vardemangder item 01 One. colless-unplaced (461): a literal blank column 2020 beside UNPLACED in the unparseable edition 'okänd'. ty-conflict (471): Datatyp date and integer on two 2020 members, SWECOV storage CIS2020=int; ty-widen (472): varchar (Datalängd 18) and float (53), storage CIS2018=int and CIS2020=float. coded (481): one Vardemangder item 01 One whose list version is 'Supplied list label'. SOS PAR_OV: OPEN delivered from 2004 with a blank Data till and the undated Kodlista row 01 One; SPLIT 2019-2021 with Kodlista rows 0 No (2019-2021) and 1 Yes (2020).
